map.矩形遗址用取整加边界法：行数=ceil(南北长/规格)、列数=ceil(东西宽/: For rectangular sites use the ceil-plus-boundary method: rows=ceil(north-south length/spec), cols=ceil(east-west width/spec), then subtract corner pits fully outside the site.
map.列数=ceil(100/5)=20，行数=ceil(60/5)=12，探方总数=: Cols=ceil(100/5)=20, rows=ceil(60/5)=12, total pits=20×12=240, excavation area=240×25=6000 m². The southwest first pit is marked T0000 (or T0101 by convention); column number increases eastward, row number increases northward.
